notes: Profile: Mid-market product analytics SaaS building an in-app assistant, semantic search, and candidate reranking for product discovery. Evaluating Hosted API first; strong intent to move to Dedicated for predictable costs and VPC isolation.
Discovery call 2025-11-12: AE Aisha Khan + SE Diego Morales. High-level reqs: p50 latency <200ms for 256-token prompts, p95 <600ms; throughput variability during business hours.

Hosted API trial summary (Jan 2026): 3-week trial, 1200 sessions sampled. Average completion tokens 380, prompt tokens 120 (avg session ~500 tokens). Call mix: 30% chat (multi-turn), 50% embeddings (search index), 20% reranking/batch scoring.
Observed traffic: baseline 20 QPS, daily peaks 80-120 QPS during PST business hours. Token mix leads to 60% of cost from long completions (>=800 tokens) generated during analytics flows.

Customer forecasts: internal product roadmap implies 30% QoQ growth. If feature launches broadly, expect peak QPS ~350 and steady-day QPS ~90 by Q3 2026. Wants guidance mapping QPS/concurrency to Dedicated GPU count.

Capacity ask: SE requested a dedicated sizing workshop to model 99th percentile latency under mixed workload. Initial SE estimate: 3-5 A100-equivalent instances depending on model variant and quantization (8-bit) with burst headroom for marketing-driven spikes.

Token mix & concurrency details provided by customer: typical session = 3 turns, avg turn tokens: prompt 120 / completion 380; concurrency target during peak = 120 concurrent open sessions (not simple QPS).

Pricing sensitivity: product team prefers committed monthly pricing to control unit economics; procurement expects 3 pricing scenarios (small/medium/large commit) with overage rates and reserved vs burst delineation. Target ARR band $50k-$150k.
Stakeholders: VP Product Maya Lin, Head of Engineering Jordan Peters, Security Lead Anil Shah. Primary champion: Senior PM Rohan Desai (demo feedback positive).
